meaning:
βρυγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(βρύχω), [in LXX: Pro.19:12 (נַהַם), Sir.51:3 * ;]
a biting, a gnashing of teeth: Mat.8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30, Luk.13:28.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.
